evidence.quote: Class relief and attorneys’ fees were discussed together from the first round; fees were not deferred until after agreement on class relief.
we can reduce our requested fees to $5 million if Brightline increases the class fund to $32 million

summary: Plaintiffs raised fees in the first round, and fees were negotiated before the class fund was finally agreed. The transcript expressly links fees and class relief when Whitcombe offers to reduce fees if the fund increases, and plaintiff private reasoning considers fee levels along with class recovery. Defense ultimately chose Hargrove because its total deal was cheaper than Whitcombe’s, supporting a reverse-auction label. The court declaration accurately states that fees were discussed from the first round and not deferred.
